title: Customization Migration Guide - Dynamics NAV to Business Central Online

facts.text: All C/AL code customizations must be converted to AL extensions before migration.
Data from tables with code customizations cannot be carried forward unless handled by extensions on both systems.
Breaking schema changes like removing or renaming fields prevent extension synchronization.
Export C/AL objects using Export-NAVApplicationObject with ExportToNewSyntax flag.
Use Txt2Al conversion tool from version 14 to generate initial AL files.
.NET add-ins not available in online; use control add-ins, Azure Functions, or external APIs instead.
